# InlineEditableTextfield

InlineEditableTextfield — `InlineEdit` with a Text field for its edit view. It reads as the text, or the placeholder when there is none, and opens as the standard text field at the same size. Validation shows under the field through the field's own caption, and a failed `onConfirm` shows there too. With `value` the parent holds the text; without it, the field keeps what was last confirmed.

**Import:** `import { InlineEditableTextfield } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/InlineEditableTextfield/InlineEditableTextfield.jsx`

**Motion:** change `appearance.fast` · rejected `spatial.fast`. Read the tokens through `--ds-motion-*`; see Foundations › Expression › Motion.

## Motion

InlineEditableTextfield reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| change | Swap content in place | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Read and edit states swap in place. |
| rejected | Call attention | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` | A blocked save shakes the field and its button once. |
